sloka: मां वा गृह्णीयुराप्लुत्य बहवः शीघ्रकारिणः ।स्यादियं चागृहीतार्था मम च ग्रहणं भवेत् ।। ५.३०.२९।।।।
transliteration: māṁ vā gṛhṇīyurāplutya bahavaḥ śīghrakāriṇaḥ ।syādiyaṁ cāgṛhītārthā mama ca grahaṇaṁ bhavet ।। 5.30.29।।।।

translations.english: "The ogres who are in large numbers, here are very prompt to act. They will jump into the sky and bind me. Sita will not receive the message and I will be taken into custody by the demons.
